name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write an OpenQASM 3 program using mid-ci
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write an OpenQASM 3 program using mid-circuit measurement and an if statement to implement active qubit reset followed by an X gate conditioned on the outcome (quantum coin flip + correction), with Python verification via qiskit and AerSimulator. Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
